roles.title: AI Consulting Associate Program (AI CAP) Product Owner Intern, Summer 2027

bullets: Design, prototype, and develop agentic AI workflows that automate or augment business or engineering tasks (for example, analysis, triage, documentation, and knowledge synthesis)
Build internal tools or proof-of-concept systems that combine LLMs, APIs, and automation frameworks into end-to-end agentic solutions
Experiment with different agent architectures (single-agent vs. multi-agent, planner/executor patterns, human-in-the-loop workflows) and document tradeoffs
Apply best practices when building AI-driven automation
Evaluate agent behavior for reliability, correctness, and failure modes, and propose improvements
Define and document business and technical requirements for options execution services, including API specifications, order lifecycle flows, and edge cases
Test and validate REST API endpoints in Postman, including request and response payloads, error handling, and regression scenarios
Write SQL queries to investigate trade, order, and position data, reconcile across systems, and diagnose production issues
Partner effectively with your design, compliance, brokerage, operations, and engineering team to build, test, and launch options features
Consolidate feedback from internal stakeholders and partners on their experience to continuously improve our offering
